scenarios.name: normal_mixing
scenarios.description: Reference vector: MAT 18 °C with OAT 5 / RAT 22 sits 13 °C above the low bound; nothing to report

scenarios.name: mat_below_envelope
scenarios.description: Reference vector: MAT 1 °C is 4 °C below min(oat, rat) = 5 °C, twice the tolerance; alarms at alarm_delay (1800 s)

scenarios.name: within_tolerance
scenarios.description: Reference vector: MAT 4 °C is 1 °C below the low bound — inside eps_MAT, so the sensor pair is still plausible

scenarios.name: edge_gap_equals_tolerance
scenarios.description: Threshold edge: min(oat, rat) − mat = 2.0 °C exactly; the comparison is strict, so this is healthy

scenarios.name: edge_gap_just_over_tolerance
scenarios.description: Threshold edge, other side: a gap of 2.1 °C clears the strict comparison and alarms at alarm_delay

scenarios.name: summer_oat_above_rat
scenarios.description: Cooling season with OAT above RAT: RAT 24 °C is now the low bound and MAT 20 °C sits 4 °C under it

scenarios.name: high_excursion_is_not_this_fault
scenarios.description: MAT 26 °C is 4 °C above the envelope — a real violation, but the high side belongs to AHU-0003

scenarios.name: transient_excursion_never_alarms
scenarios.description: MAT drops below the bound for 1200 s (< alarm_delay) during a damper stroke and recovers; the timer resets unfired

scenarios.name: fault_clears_on_recovery
scenarios.description: Sustained low excursion alarms at 1800 s; recalibration at 3600 s drops the alarm on the same tick
